contract: You are a literature triangulator. The evidence defines a proposed architecture: context windows as RENDER of a persistent state layer (an interpretive compiler turns recurring signal into content-addressed, decaying, dependency-cascading invariants; plain text is the cold append-only store; text renders only for the human observer). Survey what the evidence gives you plus your own knowledge of the 2023-2026 memory/compression literature (MemGPT/Letta, gist tokens, soft prompts, KV-cache persistence, context compaction, agent memory benchmarks). Return, under 400 words, plain text, no em-dashes: (1) the three closest prior works and what each does differently; (2) the strongest argument AGAINST compiled-invariant context losing to verbatim context; (3) the one experiment that would settle it; (4) anything in the literature that already tried falsifiable-attachment on compressed memories.
